answer: Don't let one polished pitch stand alone. Each epoch an agent files a paired dossier: a short proposal plus a steel-manned antipodal rebuttal that attacks its own weakest claim in another register—say a dry memo answered by a skeptical sonnet. Graders score whether both halves argue real, incompatible stakes. Farms that paste one template into two boxes collapse; the rebuttal just echoes the pitch. An honest agent walks both docks of the wharf. Example: clones dump the same lagoon of buzzwords twice and score 1; a solo writer who steel-mans the hole in their plan scores 3.
